title: SourceAuth
description: Credential reference. Every secret is a named server-side environment variable resolved at read time; the Card carries only the env-var *name*, never a secret value (Doctrine #7).

oneOf.description: Single secret read from one env var (bearer token, password, connection secret, key-pair, or service-account JSON delivered via env).

env.description: Server-side env-var name holding the secret.

oneOf.description: Username (non-secret) plus a password read from an env var.

password_env.description: Server-side env-var name holding the password.

oneOf.description: Multiple named secrets, each read from its own env var. Keys are logical credential names (e.g. `api_key`, `app_key`); values are env-var names.

vars.description: Logical credential name → server-side env-var name.
